visual.oil: Transmitted oil films, a swirl, a glass slide or fluid droplets.
visual.geometric: An abstract geometric pattern such as shapes, stars, circles, polygons or a tunnel.
visual.silhouette: A keyed dancer, animal, figure or rotoscoped silhouette.
visual.video: A full-colour video or cartoon clip.

signal.energy_rise: Rising loudness, crescendo or increasing energy.
signal.lyric: A sung word, line of lyrics or verse.
signal.time: An exact time interval independent of the audio.

fit.elastic: Stretch movement to fit the selected interval.
fit.repeat: Loop an element repeatedly within the selected region.
fit.recurrence: Return at every subsequent occurrence of a recurring cue.
